items.synopsis: Commit failure when configuring any WAN interface with the keyword unused
items.description: On the PTX10002-36QDD platform running Junos Evolved, any configuration that includes a Wide Area Network (WAN) interface with the keyword unused fails to commit, without impacting protocols or traffic on the WAN interface.

items.synopsis: [PTX10002] When the system is rebooted with "power-optimized" configured, a "FPC 0 Major Errors" alarm is triggered due to a pll_lock_error on the BX chip.
items.description: On the PTX10002, when the system is rebooted with the power-optimized setting enabled, a "PLL lock error" may be detected, and an "FPC 0 Major Errors" alarm may be observed.

items.synopsis: AS path loop may not be detected with VPN route when autonomous-system independent-domain is configured with 'no-attrset' option
items.description: AS path loop may not be detected with VPN route when autonomous-system independent-domain is configured with 'no-attrset' option under routing-options hierarchy

items.category: QOS issues in EVO for BCM XGS Platforms
items.synopsis: ECN CE bit is not set in an EVPN-VxLAN scenario
items.description: On QFX5130/QFX5700 platforms, in Ethernet VPN-Virtual Extensible LAN (EVPN-VxLAN) scenario, the Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) Congestion Experienced (CE) bit will not be set for ECN-capable traffic when there is congestion. Since the CE bit is not set, packets will be dropped.

items.category: PFE L2 forwarding features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: On PTX EVO platforms in EVPN-VXLAN scenario traffic will not egress out of the irb next-hop when the bridge-domain doesn't have VXLAN VNI configured
items.description: On all PTX Evolved platforms that support EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet VPN-Virtual Extensible LAN), when the PTX router acts as a MAC-VRF (Media Access Control - Virtual Routing and Forwarding) EVPN gateway, it will fail to forward traffic routed through the 'irb' interface due to packets being discarded at PFE (packet forwarding Engine), causing packet loss.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss observed when restart routing is performed on L3VPN BGP-LU setup
items.description: On PTX10001-36MR, PTX10008 and PTX10016 Junos platforms, when preserve-nexthop-hierarchy is configured and restart routing is performed, then ipv4/ipv6 Layer 3 Virtual Private Network(l3vpn) traffic going over Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)-Labelled Unicast (LU) path may get dropped on downstream routers due to next hop not getting updated properly.

items.synopsis: Disabling On Box Blackhole Detection by Default
items.description: Reverting the "Blackhole Detection" from the "default on" to the "default off". This makes the behavior consistent with pre-Junos Evolved 25.4-EVO software.

items.synopsis: Traffic dropped after priority change in VRRP with EVPN-VxLAN scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, in Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol (VRRP) with Ethernet Virtual Private Network - Virtual Extensible Local Area Network (EVPN-VXLAN) scenario, when VRRP priority is changed, the VRRP virtual Media Access Control (MAC) address can remain pinned as a static entry on the remote device. As a result, MAC movement does not occur correctly, and VRRP packets are dropped on the leaf device. This impacts VRRP operation after priority changes.

items.synopsis: Telemetry subscription to path /qos/interfaces/interface/output/ queues/queue/state/transmit-pkts showing incorrect result
items.description: Telemetry subscription to path /qos/interfaces/interface/output/queues/ queue/state/transmit-pkts showing incorrect result

items.synopsis: SNMP traps related to optics/optic's media lane alarms will not be raised
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, SNMP(Simple Network Management Protocol) management systems do not receive related to optics or transceiver lane and module alarm traps.

items.category: Enhanced Broadband Edge support for firewall
items.synopsis: FPC crash occurs after configuration changes are made to a service-filter on specific MX platforms
items.description: FPC crash and aftd-trio core-dump will be observed on MX platforms supporting MPC10E, MPC11E, LC9600 line cards, and MX304 after configuration changes were made to a service-filter which was in use by BBE subscribers.

items.synopsis: PTP delay message sent from different LAG after RE switchover
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved ACX7332 and ACX7348 platforms, after Routing Engines( RE) switchover the Precision Time Protocol (PTP) delay message is sent from different REs when Link Aggregation Group (LAG) members are configured on different Flexible PIC Concentrators (FPCs) leading to PTP timing discrepancy.

items.synopsis: CRC errors and packet loss are being observed at the peer device when using 1G fibre optic connections
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved ACX7509, ACX7348, ACX7332, and ACX7100-32C platforms with 1G fibre Optics, when the Inter-Packet Gap (IPG) setting intermittently falls below the IEEE minimum requirement of 8 bytes, and traffic passes through the PHY, certain receiving devices are sensitive to this reduced IPG, which leads to CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) errors and packet loss on the peer device connected to 1G fibre optics connection.

items.synopsis: A buffer overflow during IPv6 NDP operations in an EVPN environment caused segmentation faults leading to FPC crash files and repeated reboots
items.description: On JunOS MX240/MX480/MX960/ MX2008/MX2010/MX2020 platforms with MPC10E/MPC11E line cards as well as the MX304 platform, an issue in IPv6 EVPN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network) during NDP (Neighbor Discovery Protocol) resolicitation of a link local target address causes the system to use the IRB link local address in outgoing packets. Stack corruption happens when handling the IRB link local address and resulting in continuous FPC (Flexible PIC Concentrator) reboots (around 3 or 4 times) and crash files generation.

items.category: Port-based link layer security services and protocols that a
items.synopsis: License Feature used is shown 0 for MACSec Bandwidth Usage (in gbps) although MACSec license is installed and used
items.description: License Feature used is shown 0 for MACSec Bandwidth Usage (in gbps), although MACSec license is installed and used.

items.synopsis: The auditd process crashes when the Radius server is configured but unreachable
items.description: On Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved having the Radius (Remote Authentication Dial-In User Service) server with accounting configured, the auditd crash is observed if the Radius server is unreachable for a long time and a large number of accounting records accumulate, which leads to memory exhaustion during accounting processing and results in a process crash.

items.category: PFE L2 forwarding features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: IRB routed traffic is dropped when both hosts are learned on the same SP-style Layer 2 interface on EVO-PTX platforms
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved PTX platforms, IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) routed traffic is dropped when both source and destination hosts are reachable through the same Service Provider (SP)-style Layer 2 IFL (Logical Interface) and associated IRB interface.

items.synopsis: dscp-code-point under host-outbound-traffic is not enabled on PTX
items.description: set class-of-service host-outbound-traffic dscp-code-point was disabled on PTX in 25.4R1. Later it was enabled in 26.2R1 and backported to 25.4R2

items.synopsis: JDI-REG:VIRTUAL:EVO-Suite fails due to SSH reconnection timeout as textchannel creation to RE device fails after reboot
items.description: EVO-Suite fails due to SSH reconnection timeout as textchannel creation to RE device fails after reboot

items.synopsis: Dropping packets on PTX PE from any ingress PE device adds padding to IPv6 packets going over MPLS L3VPN
items.description: On all Junos Evolved PTX series platforms, when acting as egress PE router, it drops padded packets from any ingress PE device. When this occurs, the packets that are discarded are padding to small IPv6 packets going over MPLS L3VPN. If the padding is removed, they are forwarded as expected.

items.synopsis: Rescue Configuration Check Fails
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved ACX platforms, that cannot verify the syntax and integrity of the saved rescue configuration file when performing a configuration check.

items.category: Port-based link layer security services and protocols that a
items.synopsis: MACsec traffic encryption/decryption failure post SFP OIR with interface and session in up state
items.description: On MX301 platform, After SFP (Small Form-factor Pluggable transceiver) Online Insertion and Removal (OIR) on a MACsec (Media Access Control Security) enabled interface, the link and MACsec session remain UP, but MACsec encryption and decryption stop functioning. This results in traffic loss and causes service impact.

items.synopsis: After hitless reboot, "unused" ports remain "Disabled" in HW
items.description: To ensure proper functionality of hitless restart/ISSU, do not mark any port as "unused".

items.synopsis: Hillside: 16x100G PIC: Commit check added when 40G and 100G xcvrs are put to share a Broadcom serdes core
items.description: Hillside: 16x100G PIC: Commit check added when 40G and 100G xcvrs are put to share a Broadcom serdes core

items.category: PTX10K Line Card specific interface PRs
items.synopsis: Incorrect module temperature readings trigger unintended optics shutdown
items.description: On MX platforms with MPC11, LC9600, LC4800 Linecards, MX304 and all Junos OS Evolved platforms, optics modules intermittently reports extremely high false temperature values in "show interfaces diagnostics optics" command. This can trigger false high-temperature alarms, leading to unnecessary optics shutdown.
